title: 5 Days Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training Course in Bali, Indonesia
metaTitle: 5 Days Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training in Bali | BYS
metaDescription: Join the Best 5 Days Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. Learn safe pregnancy yoga practices, postnatal recovery techniques, and earn an internationally recognized certification at Bali Yoga School.
summary: A 5-day prenatal and postnatal yoga training in Ubud for yoga teachers, healthcare providers and mothers who wish to support women through pregnancy and after birth.
intro: At Bali Yoga School, we believe that a woman in pregnancy deserves more than generic advice and good wishes. She needs professional, caring, knowledgeable assistance and so do all who would provide it to her. Our 5 Days Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training Course in Ubud was built from that belief. We have designed our course to prepare yoga teachers, healthcare providers and mothers to step into the world of women in this phase of their lives.

Bali Yoga School's prenatal yoga training is well-designed to meet the changing requirements of pregnant women throughout all phases of pregnancy, including the first trimester, the middle and late term, and the very end before birth. You will depart with the expertise to design safe, nourishing and effective classes for women at all points along this path.

Post Natal Yoga provides moms with a solid, natural approach to reconnecting with themselves. It is designed to restore core strength, supporting the recovery of the pelvis, easing the postpartum anxiety and gently reconnecting the inner balance needed for the woman to care for her baby and herself.

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. One of the primary practices in yoga is ahimsa, meaning non-violence. By following a plant-based diet during your training, you are in the practice of ahimsa.

prerequisites: No previous yoga experience is necessary.
Women who are expecting who would like to have a more conscious pregnancy that will be healthier, based on true yogic knowledge and practice of self.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Deposits are non-refundable but can be transferred to another upcoming course at Bali Yoga School. The deposit remains valid for a lifetime and may be used toward future training programs.

policies.title: Management Authority
items: The management team is authorised to make the necessary changes in the daily schedule if needed.

policies.title: Course Booking & Confirmation
items: To book for the course, please deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD. An official confirmation letter for your program will be sent shortly after successful payment.

policies.title: Asanas Class
items: The purpose of the asana classes is to support your body and mind. These sessions promote personal well-being rather than provide professional-level training in asanas or alignment techniques.

policies.title: 1 Hour Self Practice
items: You can engage in a one-hour self-practice session in the HYA Healing Studio using available instruments. Any damage to equipment during practice must be covered by you.

policies.title: Important Note
items: The school reserves the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.
